parent_objective: run no-training bounded relocation replay smoke on M1425 pressure rows
blocked_by: M1428 implementation must be exercised in a separately registered public replay smoke

public_gates: M1429 must run no-training bounded relocation replay on public M1425 pressure rows
M1429 must count history-positive only from actual replay rows
M1429 must report reset and zero-current controls separately
M1429 must not train run PPO promote use private holdout export corpus or change actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not export a training corpus
do not count proxy rows as replay evidence
do not count reset or zero-current controls as history-positive

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: runs the bounded relocation replay probe to test actual terminal-margin sensitivity for M1425 pressure rows
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: public proof smoke only; no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if control positives dominate history positives
stop if actor parameters or actor inputs change
fallback_plan: audit no-history-positive result if actual replay rows are sufficient but negative
audit trace/reconstruction failure if replay rows are sparse
admit branch synthesis before more retuning if public replay is negative

admission_evidence: M1428 implementation and focused tests pass
allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
next_stage_criteria: replay smoke gates pass or fail clearly
history-positive and control-positive rows are separated

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1429 can only show public replay sensitivity; it cannot alone prove level3 anticipatory self-identification.
history_necessity_tests: actual relocated replay with requested history variant
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1425 pressure rows replayed under relocated obstacle geometry.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If history-positive rows remain zero, record a negative and audit before retuning or changing thresholds.
allowed_claims: bounded relocation replay public smoke result
no promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: Actual bounded relocation replay can reveal history-positive terminal-margin sensitivity that the M1425 shared-margin proxy could not show.
failure_criteria: selected or replay rows are sparse
history-positive rows are zero or not source-diverse
control positives are mixed into history positives
run starts training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export or actor-input changes

commands.name: replay_smoke
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m autodrift.bounded_relocation_replay_probe --checkpoint runs/m1362_bidirectional_active_set_interpolation_preflight/checkpoints/alpha_0_1.pt --config configs/m1419_warmup_gate_invasiveness_retune_source_wave.json --candidate-rows runs/m1425_action_divergent_outcome_pressure_source_smoke/outcome_pressure_rows.csv --max-candidate-rows 128 --per-capability-pair-cap 12 --history-length 56 --recent-window-length 4 --max-continuation-steps 48 --device cpu --run-dir runs/m1429_bounded_relocation_replay_smoke

decision_rule: M1429 passes only if actual replay, not proxy accounting, yields source-diverse history-positive rows without forbidden shortcuts.
